lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: CRITICAL fix from review round 1 (CAM-360): buildStatusReport's `operatorPaused = isPauseSet(claudeDir)` was reading the pause marker from the WRONG directory in production. `claudeDir` in status.ts defaults to `process.env['CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR'] ?? join(os.homedir(), '.claude')` -- the GLOBAL Claude config dir, used ONLY for orchestrator-transcript lookup (`orchestratorTranscriptPath`). But `cam pause` (pause.ts) always writes `.cam-pause` under the PROJECT-LOCAL `<cwd>/.claude`, matching host.ts:537 and stop.ts:424. In production these two directories diverge, so `cam status` never saw the marker. Fix: `buildStatusReport` now calls `isPauseSet(join(cwd, '.claude'))` directly -- NEVER `isPauseSet(claudeDir)` -- so any future edit to status.ts must keep the pause-marker read hard-anchored to `<cwd>/.claude`, independent of the `options.claudeDir` override (which remains transcript-only). The 4 pre-existing tests in test/commands/status-paused.test.ts previously passed `setPause(claudeDir)` with `claudeDir` being a directory DIFFERENT from `<cwd>/.claude` and equal to what was passed back into buildStatusReport as `options.claudeDir` -- this was the fakes-lie pattern that masked the bug (CAM-55). They now call `setPause(join(cwd, '.claude'))` instead, while still passing a separate `claudeDir` into buildStatusReport/runStatus to prove the marker read is independent of that option. Added a new real end-to-end test: `runPause({cwd})` -> `buildStatusReport({cwd})` with the DEFAULT `claudeDir` (no `options.claudeDir` passed) and `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` env pointed at a deliberately different tmp dir, asserting `operator-paused`. File-size ceiling raised for src/commands/status.ts (636->642) in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a dated _ref note citing CAM-360/US-R1-001; staged and committed in the same commit as the fix.
